title: Wire EntityObservedEvent into StructuredFacts (F33)
description:
## Finding F33 (Council: P1, 92% confidence)

EntityObservedEvent writes entity observation data to WorldState.Facts (the untyped legacy dict with no eviction) rather than WorldState.StructuredFacts (provenance-tracked with a trim mechanism). This means entity observations accumulate indefinitely in the legacy dict, consuming memory and never being evicted. The StructuredFacts system was designed specifically to handle this use case.

## Effect
Entity facts in the legacy Facts dict grow without bound during long agent sessions. The StructuredFacts trim mechanism cannot clean them, so stale entity positions persist indefinitely.

## Recommendation
1. Change EntityObservedEvent handler to write to StructuredFacts instead of Facts
2. Ensure the provenance tracking includes entity ID, observation time, and confidence
3. Add TTL-based eviction for stale entity observations (default: 60s)
4. Verify that consumers reading entity data check both stores or are migrated to StructuredFacts
